instantPotCopycats.name: Rosa's Café & Tortilla Factory Queso Supreme
instantPotCopycats.description: Creamy, restaurant-style queso dip made in Instant Pot

steps.instruction: Set Instant Pot to sauté mode, add butter and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant
steps.tip: Don't brown - keep heat medium to prevent burning

steps.instruction: Add roasted poblano and jalapeño peppers (charred and diced)
Add heavy cream and diced cheddar cheese gradually, stirring
steps.tip: Low heat prevents cheese from breaking

steps.instruction: Season with salt, pepper, and fresh cilantro
Transfer to serving dish, serve warm with tortilla chips
steps.tip: Keep warm on slow cooker setting

cookingTips: Roast poblano peppers over flame until blistered, then peel
Use block cheese for better texture than pre-shredded
Don't let cream boil - keep temperature below 180°F
Add cream slowly to prevent curdling
Can make ahead and reheat gently

instantPotCopycats.name: Chipotle Queso Blanco
instantPotCopycats.description: Creamy white cheese dip with smoky chipotle

steps.instruction: Chop Oaxaca cheese into small pieces for even melting
Blend chipotle peppers with cream until smooth
steps.tip: Strain if you want less texture

steps.instruction: Set Instant Pot to sauté, add diced onion and garlic
Add chipotle cream mixture, then cheese slowly
Finish with lime juice and salt to taste

cookingTips: Oaxaca cheese has higher water content - helps create creamy texture
Adobo sauce from canned chipotles adds depth
Keep temperature low to prevent breaking
Serve immediately for best texture
Reheats well on low setting

instantPotCopycats.name: Chili's White Spinach Queso

steps.instruction: Blanch fresh spinach in salted water for 2 minutes, squeeze dry
Set Instant Pot to sauté, add minced garlic
Add heavy cream and bring to gentle simmer
Add cream cheese first, then white cheddar, stirring constantly
steps.tip: Add cheese slowly to prevent separation

steps.instruction: Fold in spinach and diced jalapeños, season with salt, pepper, nutmeg

cookingTips: Blanch spinach to remove bitterness and excess moisture
Cream cheese helps emulsify and creates smooth texture
White pepper instead of black for restaurant appearance
Jalapeños add freshness and slight heat
Keep on warm setting to prevent scorching on bottom

instantPotCopycats.name: Benihana Onion Soup

steps.instruction: Slice onions into 1/4 inch thick rings
Set Instant Pot to sauté, melt butter and cook onions over medium-high heat
steps.tip: Caramelize until deep golden brown - don't rush this

steps.instruction: Add minced ginger and garlic, toast for 1 minute
Deglaze with sake, scraping up browned bits, then add beef stock
Pressure cook on high for 15 minutes, then natural release
Stir in soy sauce and sugar, taste and adjust

cookingTips: Deep caramelization is key - takes 15-20 minutes minimum
Don't skip deglazing - those browned bits are flavor gold
Natural release preserves delicate onion flavor
Sake adds sweetness and removes any metallic notes
Soy sauce provides umami depth
Can make day ahead, reheat gently

instantPotCopycats.name: Panera Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instantPotCopycats.description: Creamy, hearty broccoli and cheddar soup

steps.instruction: Set Instant Pot to sauté, cook diced onion in butter until soft
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds
Add chopped broccoli and stock, pressure cook 8 minutes
Blend with immersion blender until creamy
steps.tip: Leave some small broccoli pieces for texture

steps.instruction: Set to sauté, stir in cream, then cheese slowly
steps.tip: Low heat prevents cheese from breaking

steps.instruction: Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg

cookingTips: Use sharp cheddar for more flavor
Blend to desired consistency - some prefer chunkier
Add cream after blending to prevent scorching
Keep temperature below 180°F when adding cheese
Can thin with more stock if too thick
Freezes well - reheat on low heat with extra cream

afghanRecipes.name: Badenjan Buranie
afghanRecipes.subtitle: Eggplants and Peppers
afghanRecipes.description: Traditional Afghan appetizer of fried eggplants and peppers with yogurt sauce

steps.instruction: Cut eggplants into 1cm thick slices, slice onions and red bell peppers into 1/4 inch rings
steps.tip: Keep slices uniform for even cooking

steps.instruction: Pour 4 tbsp oil into frying pan, fry eggplant a few at a time until lightly browned on each side
steps.tip: When eggplant releases oil it absorbed, it's ready to plate. Add more oil as needed

steps.instruction: Layer eggplant, onion rings, and pepper rings in pan, sprinkle salt between layers
Pour tomato puree and water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until eggplant is tender
steps.tip: Don't overcook - eggplant should be slightly firm

steps.instruction: Mix yogurt with crushed garlic and salt in separate bowl
steps.tip: Use fresh garlic for best flavor

steps.instruction: Spread half of yogurt on serving dish, layer vegetables on top, top with remaining yogurt and tomato juices
steps.tip: Sprinkle with dried mint, serve warm with bread

cookingTips: Instead of frying, sear eggplant in dry pan for lighter version
Browning eggplant properly is key - too pale means no flavor
Garlic-yogurt sauce brightens the rich eggplant
Serve warm or cold as appetizer

balkanRecipes.name: Cornbread with Cheese and Kaymak
balkanRecipes.subtitle: Yugoslav Appetizer
balkanRecipes.description: Golden cornbread with melted cheese and creamy kaymak

steps.instruction: Mix maize flour and semolina together
Crush cheese well, add kaymak or sour cream, mix with egg yolks, oil, and mineral water
Add mixed corn flour and semolina to wet mixture, fold gently
Whisk egg whites stiffly, fold in carefully
steps.tip: Whipped egg whites create light, airy texture

steps.instruction: Grease baking pan with oil, pour mixture in, bake 50 min at 175°C
steps.tip: Test with fork - should come out clean

steps.instruction: Cool slightly, cut into squares, serve with cheese or yogurt

cookingTips: Oil prevents sticking better than butter in cornbread
Whipped eggs create lift and airiness
Kaymak (sour cream) adds richness and tang
Mineral water adds lightness
Can be served as appetizer or side dish

hopelessCooksRecipes.name: Bangers and Mash
hopelessCooksRecipes.subtitle: Saucisse et Pomme de Terre
hopelessCooksRecipes.description: Simple, practical dinner - sausages and potatoes that even beginners can master

steps.instruction: Simmer sausages in water for about 10 minutes until cooked. Remove skins
Put sausages in frying pan on medium heat to brown
steps.tip: This adds nice color and flavor

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until cooked. Can mash or serve as chunks
steps.tip: Chunks fill you up faster than mash

steps.instruction: Serve before the delicious smell forces everyone to attack the kitchen
steps.tip: Serve hot with gravy if desired

cookingTips: Don't skip the simmering step - it cooks sausages through
Browning adds color and flavor
Either mash or chunks work - it's about preference
This is a forgiving recipe - hard to mess up
Great for practicing basic cooking skills
hopelessCooksRecipes.source: The Hopeless Cooks Cookbook - Carol Staines

mexicanKitchenRecipes.name: Chicken Tinga
mexicanKitchenRecipes.subtitle: Shredded Chicken in Chipotle Sauce
mexicanKitchenRecipes.description: Smoky, tender shredded chicken in rich chipotle sauce

steps.instruction: Heat oil in slow cooker, brown chicken thighs on both sides (3 min per side)
Blend chipotle peppers with adobo sauce, diced tomatoes, and garlic
Pour sauce over chicken, add stock, cover and cook on low 6-8 hours
steps.tip: Long, slow cooking develops deep flavors

steps.instruction: Shred chicken directly in slow cooker using two forks
steps.tip: Let it cool slightly for easier shredding

steps.instruction: Heat on high for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce reduces slightly
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh cilantro

cookingTips: Chicken thighs stay moist longer than breasts
Chipotle peppers are key - they're smoked jalapeños
Adobo sauce adds sweetness and depth
Slow cooking is essential for tender, shredded chicken
Serve with rice, tortillas, or as a topping
Makes great leftovers - reheats beautifully

sovietCookingRecipes.name: Borscht
sovietCookingRecipes.subtitle: Eastern European Beet Soup
sovietCookingRecipes.description: Deep red, earthy beet soup with sour cream

steps.instruction: Peel and cut beets, carrots, potatoes into matchsticks or small dice
Heat oil in large pot, sauté chopped onion until golden
Add tomato paste, stir well, cook 2 minutes
Add beef stock, bring to boil, add potatoes, carrots, bay leaves
Add shredded cabbage, beets, and diced apple
Simmer 30-40 minutes until beets are tender, season with vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper
steps.tip: Vinegar and sugar balance earthy beet flavor

steps.instruction: Serve hot with dollop of sour cream and fresh dill
steps.tip: Sour cream and dill are traditional

cookingTips: Fresh beets have better flavor than canned
Beets bleed color - add last to maintain color integrity
Apple is traditional - adds subtle sweetness
Vinegar is essential - balances earthiness
Sour cream mellows the strong beet flavor
Tastes better the next day as flavors meld
Can be served hot or cold
sovietCookingRecipes.source: Mastering the Art of Soviet Cooking - Anya Von Bremzen
